articles.title: Xi visit delivers coal deal, tariff talks — and plenty of unresolved issues - politico.com
articles.description: The U.S. says China will buy more American coal and that the two sides made progress on future tariff carveouts, capping a Washington visit from President Xi Jinping that was thin on deliverables.
